notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content: - Fixed an intermittent issue with enemies not taking an action in combat, effectively freezing the game.

notes.title: The Land Past Redemption Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Hi all,

We will be releasing into 1.0 on March 29, 2024!

We're going to be making some changes based on user feedback.

Version 1.0 will include fixes for bugs and issues reported during the Next Fest.
[i](Thanks to everyone who left feedback!)[/i]

We'll also be adding more events and doing some more rebalancing.

We hope you'll give it a look on release day!

Thanks!


- Up Next Games team
